name: Auto-Novel
source:
Today is the 8th March, and our MC must do whatever it takes to not ruin it(and ofc find his GF of his dreams)! Will he be able to survive in this AWFUL RANDOMISED VN WITHOUT BEING ABLE TO CHOOSE?

[From [url=https://fangame.itch.io/untitledautonovelgamewithdumbrandom]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
今天是3月8日，我们的MC必须尽一切努力不破坏它（并找到他的梦想女友）！他能在这个可怕的随机越南而无法选择的情况下生存吗？

[来自[url=https://fangame.itch.io/untitledautonovelgamewithdumbrandom]itch.io[/url]]
